parts.script:
Alice: Hey, Mark! Have you thought about our weekend plans? I was thinking we should go somewhere fun.  
Mark: Great idea! I could use a break. Do you have a place in mind?  
Alice: How about the beach? It's been ages since we last went.  
Mark: The beach sounds perfect! We could try that new seafood restaurant I heard about.  
Alice: Yes! And we could also rent some bicycles to explore the area.  
Mark: I love that idea. Should we invite Jenny and Tom as well?  
Alice: Definitely! The more, the merrier. I'll text them and see if they're free.  
Mark: What time are you thinking of leaving?  
Alice: I was thinking early Saturday morning. We can beat the traffic.  
Mark: Good plan! Do you want to pack some snacks for the road?  
Alice: Sure, I can handle that. How about you bring some drinks?  
Mark: Sounds good! I can't wait for this getaway!  
Alice: Me too! Let’s finalize all the details tonight.  
Mark: Great! I’ll start looking up bike rental places online.  
Alice: Perfect, and I'll check the restaurant’s menu to make a reservation.  
Mark: Awesome. This will be a fun weekend!  
Alice: Absolutely!
